entities.summary: Brother Alois of Taizé is the former prior of the Taizé Community in France He succeeded Brother Roger as the community's second prior after the founder's death on 16 August 2005. In 2023 he announced his resignation as prior of the community. On 2 December 2023 he was succeeded by Brother Matthew.
